title: Scalar realization of ordinary module-valued etale sheaves
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $A$ a ring in the common module universe [def-weil-size-convention]. For an ordinary $A$-module-valued sheaf $F$ on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], extend its constant scalar action to the constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], obtaining a sheaf of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define the scalar realization functor by applying module sheafification to the constant-ring presheaf action and the identity map of the underlying abelian sheaf. On morphisms use the induced module-sheafification map. Its underlying abelian sheaf and the maps on sections are unchanged. This is a definition of the scalar action and functor, with no assertion of an equivalence and no nonzero or finiteness hypothesis.
